import hashlib
import json
import plistlib
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parents[2]
release = json.loads((root / 'release-metadata.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert release['tag_name'] == 'v0.2.0'
assert not release['draft'] and not release['prerelease']
platforms = ('linux-x86_64', 'windows-x86_64', 'macos-x86_64', 'macos-aarch64')
expected = {
    'RSS-Reader-android-arm64-v8a-release.apk',
    'RSS-Reader-android-arm64-v8a-release.aab',
    'RSS-Reader-linux-x86_64.deb',
    'RSS-Reader-windows-x86_64.zip',
    'RSS-Reader-macos-x86_64.tar.gz',
    'RSS-Reader-macos-aarch64.tar.gz',
}
for platform in platforms:
    extension = 'zip' if platform.startswith('windows') else 'tar.gz'
    expected.update(f'{kind}-{platform}.{extension}' for kind in ('rssr-cli', 'rssr-web'))
assert {asset['name'] for asset in release['assets']} == expected
assert len(release['assets']) == len(expected) == 14

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

ci_files = {}
for path in (root / 'final-artifacts').glob('*/*'):
    if path.is_file() and path.name in expected:
        assert path.name not in ci_files, path.name
        ci_files[path.name] = path
assert set(ci_files) == expected, (expected - set(ci_files))
assets = []
for asset in sorted(release['assets'], key=lambda item: item['name']):
    path = root / 'public' / asset['name']
    checksum = digest(path)
    assert path.stat().st_size == asset['size']
    assert f'sha256:{checksum}' == asset['digest'], path.name
    assert checksum == digest(ci_files[path.name]), path.name
    assets.append({'name': path.name, 'size': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': checksum,
                   'ciArtifactId': int(ci_files[path.name].parent.name),
                   'publicUrl': asset['browser_download_url']})

web = []
page_files = None
for platform in platforms:
    extension = 'zip' if platform.startswith('windows') else 'tar.gz'
    archive = root / 'public' / f'rssr-web-{platform}.{extension}'
    destination = root / 'inspection' / f'final-web-{platform}'
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(repo / 'scripts/package_web.py'),
                    'unpack', str(archive), str(destination)], check=True)
    manifest = json.loads((destination / 'build.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert manifest['build_id'] == 'git-43cc00ed6ca5140e4bfd5891cb9ef250e3cf0321'
    files = {name: value for name, value in manifest['files'].items() if name.startswith('public/')}
    if page_files is None:
        page_files = files
    assert page_files == files
    web.append({'platform': platform, **manifest})

macos = []
for platform, cpu_type in [('macos-x86_64', 0x01000007), ('macos-aarch64', 0x0100000c)]:
    with tarfile.open(root / 'public' / f'RSS-Reader-{platform}.tar.gz') as archive:
        plist = plistlib.loads(archive.extractfile('RSS-Reader.app/Contents/Info.plist').read())
        assert plist['CFBundleVersion'] == plist['CFBundleShortVersionString'] == '0.2.0'
        executable = archive.extractfile('RSS-Reader.app/Contents/MacOS/' + plist['CFBundleExecutable'])
        header = executable.read(8)
        assert struct.unpack('<II', header) == (0xfeedfacf, cpu_type)
    with tarfile.open(root / 'public' / f'rssr-cli-{platform}.tar.gz') as archive:
        header = archive.extractfile('rssr-cli').read(8)
        assert struct.unpack('<II', header) == (0xfeedfacf, cpu_type)
    macos.append({'platform': platform, 'bundleVersion': '0.2.0', 'appAndCliMachOArchitecture': 'pass'})

record = {'status': 'pass', 'checkedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'releaseId': release['id'], 'releaseUrl': release['html_url'],
          'productSource': '43cc00ed6ca5140e4bfd5891cb9ef250e3cf0321',
          'workflowSource': '52b5e9fc9de57767cd0e533ce9d826949139ffb8',
          'releaseRun': 39948069776, 'assets': assets, 'webPackages': web, 'macos': macos}
(root / 'public-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('PASS: 14 public assets equal the verified CI artifacts; 4 Web manifests/pages match source; both macOS bundle versions and architectures match.')
